title: Hyperboard Extreme
description:
• Takedown your rivals to earn boost and leave them in the dust.

• Obliterate everyone with wild powerups, including pesky traffic.

• Up to 4 player local multiplayer lets you show your friends who's boss.

• Tons of racer and user interface color schemes for maximum on-track flair.

• Old-school style cheats injects unlimited experimentation.

Hyperboard Extreme is a colorful, wacky love letter to Burnout 3, Blur, and lots of other once-popular arcade racing games from the ancient times, and was handcrafted by SlyBalto and friends. Thank you for playing!

*.✧ The future is here, the future is yours ✧.*
description_short: Hyperboard Extreme combines PS2-era arcade style racing with cool girls, crazy powerups, and intense, speedy action! This is a free vertical slice as a complete proof-of-concept for the next generation of indie racers!
